If the line is encoded as any buff, each activation must reach EXACTLY 2 targets (not all allies) and rank by live effectiveAtk per the literal 'final ATK' wording (byFinalAtk:true). Fails under an `allies` target, a count!=2 slice, or static-ATK ranking. Self-skips cleanly when the line is unmodeled (the documented GAP).

TRIGGER IDENTITY — burst-cast keyed, so activations are bounded by marciana's OWN burstCast count, which is strictly less than the team fullBurstStart count in a comp holding other burst casters. Fails under the fullBurstEnter re-keying (R4), which over-credits by firing on Full Bursts she did not cast into.

Fails under targetMaxHpPct (per-ally values differ) and under an override emitting the raw percentage.

Emitted as a defPct buff to ALL allies with expiresFrame - frame === 600 (10s @ 60fps) and durationShots undefined. Fails if the line is dropped (R5 comparison), if the duration is permanent/round-counted, or if the target set is not all-allies.

Stripping the whole burst slot leaves EVERY unit's total byte-identical — defPct is inert in v1. Fails under the nearest-wrong 'make the burst do something' fix that encodes the DEF line as atkPct/attackDamagePct.

spec.assertion: No buffApply with marciana as caster carries any offensive StatKey (ATK/crit/core/damage-up/ammo/reload/fire-rate/burstGen/hitRate) and no pierce grant. Fails under any invented support buff added to make a Supporter 'contribute'.

fixtures: controlComp('marciana', true) only — liter (B1) / crown (B2) / marciana / helm (B3), boss Fire, focus on marciana, deterministic (no seed). Fixed-B3 kept ON for two reasons: (1) marciana is Burst II, so the comp needs both a B1 and a B3 for the chain to complete and Full Bursts to occur at all — a chain that never completes makes ZERO Full Bursts and renders every burst-keyed assertion vacuous; (2) her entire kit is heal / incoming-healing / DEF with no damage line of her own, so the only way a heal channel is observable as anything beyond a recovery event is through a teammate that consumes recovery — the standard control comp preserves that tandem surface and keeps the inertness baseline honest. Five hoisted runs total (well under the ~20 budget): R1 shipped override; R2 skill1 stripped; R3 skill1 lastBullet→shotFired; R4 skill2 burstCast→fullBurstEnter; R5 burst slot stripped.
gaps: skill1 [A] magnitude — 'Recovers 10.95% of attack damage as HP over 3 sec': the heal effect carries no HP amount and v1 models no HP pool, so the lifesteal-style 'of attack damage' scaler and the 3-sec HoT amount are unobservable. Only the recovery CHANNEL (count / target set / per-magazine cadence) is testable.

skill1 [B] 'Incoming healing ▲ 26.98% for 3 sec' — no incomingHealingPct StatKey exists in the effect schema and, with no HP pool, the stat would have no consumer. Belongs verbatim in unmodeled.skill1. Its TARGET SET (2 highest final ATK) is still asserted conditionally if the override encodes the line on some other stat.

burst [D] 'Storage: Stores excess healing received by the skill user, up to 27.87% of their Max HP. Lasts for 10 sec.' — no overheal-reservoir primitive; v1 has no HP pool and no overheal concept. Explicitly NOT encodable as `shield` (a shield is a damage-absorbing pool that would falsely fire teammates' `shielded` triggers / open requiresShielded gates), so a live negative assertion guards that substitution.
